notes: Factory presets. Values are plain parameter values: numbers in the parameter's unit, true/false for switches, choice names as text. A module preset sets only its module's sound parameters; anything it does not list returns to its default. Module presets never change the module's On switch, or Tune's Key, Scale, Range and note map. A chain preset picks one module preset per module, then sets the listed overrides (On switches, Basic hammers). IDs of modules that are not built yet are skipped when loading.
